title: Generator form of the diffusion chain rule
source_anchor: Sinho Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling (2026-08-09), Eq. (2.2.15) immediately after Definition 2.2.13: equivalently, a diffusion generator satisfies L(phi∘f)=phi'(f)Lf+phi''(f)Gamma(f) for observables in the generator/Gamma domain and smooth scalar phi. Chewi leaves the equivalence with Eq. (2.2.14) to Exercise 2.8.
target_statement: Introduce an explicit-domain generator-form diffusion chain-rule interface for smooth scalar phi: closure of the observable domain under phi∘f and L(phi∘f)=phi'(f)Lf+phi''(f)Gamma(f,f), together with a named-derivative pointwise specialization. Do not claim or prove equivalence with the Gamma-chain-rule interface from PR #219 in this cell.
